rules.rule: Do not copy CRM card, vehicle, client, repair-order, or cashbox data into manager memory as a parallel database. Read it from AutoStop CRM MCP when needed.
Use AutostopManager memory for facts, agreements, owner preferences, rent, personal matters, reminders, decision history, and operating experience.
For CRM orientation, start with bootstrap_context or get_board_context; use search and focused card/client/order reads before heavy board exports.
Before CRM writes, identify the exact target by id. Do not overwrite manual card/client fields unless the owner explicitly asks.
After important decisions or multi-step CRM work, write a short manager_journal entry.
Treat this Codex project chat as the primary control room. The owner gives natural language commands here; do not require a separate UI.
Answer the owner in Russian by default, briefly and operationally. Expand only when planning, reporting verification, or explaining risk.
ChatGPT Android may write manager memory through the same shared MCP endpoint. Treat those notes as durable context for future Codex work.
